objective: Write .claude/commands/sdlc-doctor.md: a read-only slash command that checks this repo's .sdlc/ state, the generated PreToolUse path-enforcement hook wiring (SS3.1), and the files listed in .sdlc/project.yaml's owned_files list for drift, then reports findings without making any changes.
non_goals: Do not implement init/migrate/uninstall (design-spec.md §9) -- those are deferred to the eventual plugin-extraction proposal.
Do not modify .sdlc/state.json, .sdlc/project.yaml, or any other file as part of running the doctor check -- it is read-only and must never call Edit or Write on any file, including its own output.
acceptance_criteria: A new file .claude/commands/sdlc-doctor.md exists, follows this repo's existing .claude/commands/continue-development.md frontmatter style (a `description` field and, if useful, `argument-hint`), and documents itself as read-only/diagnostic-only -- it must state explicitly that it never edits files.

Instructs whoever runs it (the orchestrator persona) to check: (a) every task's lifecycle_state in .sdlc/state.json is one of the values in the LIFECYCLE_STATES enum exported by scripts/sdlc/validate-state.mjs (or null) -- a sanity check on valid enum membership, not a transition check; (b) .claude/settings.json's PreToolUse hooks still contain an entry whose command references .claude/hooks/sdlc-path-check.mjs; (c) every path listed in .sdlc/project.yaml's owned_files exists on disk (glob entries like '.sdlc/**' count as satisfied if the directory exists and is non-empty); (d) every non-null task_packet_path referenced in .sdlc/state.json points to a file that actually exists at that path.
Reports findings in a clear PASS/FAIL or clean/drift-found format per check, and explicitly must not attempt to fix anything it finds -- it only reports.
A manual run against this repo in its current state (post SS0-SS4, SS5.1 itself just added) reports clean on all four checks.

A manual run after a deliberately introduced drift (e.g. hand-editing a scratch copy of .sdlc/state.json to set some task's lifecycle_state to an invalid string not in the enum, or temporarily renaming .claude/hooks/sdlc-path-check.mjs) catches and reports that specific drift -- do this test against a scratch copy or by reverting immediately after, never leave the repo's real .sdlc/state.json or .claude/hooks/sdlc-path-check.mjs actually modified when done.
